email-autoconfig.title: Email Auto-configuration
email-autoconfig.intro: Publishes IMAP/POP/SMTP settings via RFC 6186 SRV records, Mozilla Autoconfig, and Microsoft Autodiscover so mail clients can configure themselves automatically.
email-autoconfig.outgoing-hostname-desc: FQDN of your SMTP submission server.
email-autoconfig.publish-http-desc: When enabled, happyDomain creates CNAMEs for autoconfig.<your-domain> and autodiscover.<your-domain> pointing to this happyDomain instance, which serves the corresponding XML over HTTPS so Thunderbird and Outlook can self-configure.
email-autoconfig.exchange-desc: Hostname of an on-premises Microsoft Exchange server. Enables MAPI/EWS in the Autodiscover response.
